caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt divided into sixteen equally sized square blocks arranged in a 4x4 grid, each block featuring a unique design primarily composed of stylized flowers, plants, and abstract shapes. The designs are rendered in green, red, yellow, blue, and a small amount of brown, set against a cream-colored background. The blocks are separated by dark green borders, and the quilt as a whole is bordered by a pattern of green leaves. Outside the quilt on the bottom left, there is a depiction of a reclining animal, possibly a lion or a dog, filled with red, green, and yellow lines and placed within a green triangle. On the bottom right, there is a standing, four-legged animal, possibly a dog or wolf, with a green, textured body and defined tail and ears. The overall composition places the quilt centrally with the two animals outside and to the bottom corners against a plain, cream-colored background.
title: Applique and Embroidered Quilt Top
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
